name: Osananajimi na Miko-san to ~Saiji ni Koi ni... Shokushu!? Made~
original_name: 幼馴染な巫女さんと ～祭事に恋に…触手!?まで～
source:
A shrine in the neighborhood organizes a festival every decade. The content is gathering shrine maidens and serving a boy favored by the Gods. If he is not satisfied properly, he can turn into a tentacle monster, so utmost diligence must be applied.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
附近的神社每十年举办一次祭典。祭典的内容是召集巫女，侍奉一名受神明眷顾的男孩。若未能好好满足他，他就会变成触手怪物，因此必须竭尽全力。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
